WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_share) AS value
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(os.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
  AVG(os.telescope_share) AS average_share,
  AVG(os.telescope_share - a.value) AS average_share_above_average
FROM observatory_shares AS os
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE os.telescope_share > a.value;
